newsitem.title: INDIA: India's HZL zinc and lead prices for February 1997.
newsitem.headline: India's HZL zinc and lead prices for February 1997.

text.p: Following are zinc and lead prices for February 1997 announced by the state-owned Hindustan Zinc Ltd and circulated by the Bombay Metals Exchange Ltd.

HZL brand zinc and lead prices, effective February 4,1997 and valid till further notice, ex-godowns at Sewree, Thane, Kalamboli, Nagpur, Nanded, Pune, Margao, Goa, Daman, Silvassa and ex-smelters is given below:-

Over and above the basic prices declared above, excise duty of 15 percent (or actuals), octroi service charges, octroi duty and sales tax will be charged extra. In the case of sale within the Goa state, local sales-tax of 2.0 percent will be charged extra if sale is made to customers outside Goa state, a CST of 2.0 percent will be levied against Form C.

'C' Forms are to be submitted on a bill-wise basis. In the case of sale within Daman a local sales tax of 6.0 percent will be charged extra. If the sale is made to customers outside Daman, a CST of 4.0 percent will be charged against form C. In the case of sale within Silvasa, a local sales tax of 7.0 percent will be charged extra. If the sale is made to customers outside Silvasa,a CST of 4.0 percent will be charged against Form C.
* Against advance payment, Pay Order/Demand Draft is to be given.

* Against credit sale, confirmed irrevocable a letter of credit payable at Fort/Nariman Point, Mumbai is to be submitted. If any party wants to open L/C payable at Mumbai-suburbs then, it will be the responsibility of the customer to deliver the pay order to our SBBJ Bank at D.N. Road or to HZL, Mumbai office, failing which 24 percent interest to be paid by the party.
Please note that in the case of Daman And Silvasa sales tax will be nil against submission of form 11.
